about: Dish tags for the 97 MICHELIN Bib Gourmand Singapore 2026 eateries, assigned by an LLM (Claude) on 1 Nov 2026. Each tag rests on the eatery's name plus the dishes named in its MICHELIN Guide description (as reported by the search index, see stalls_source.json 'michelin_says'); where Michelin's text named no dish, a published review is cited in 'reason'. 'ambiguous' is true when the name alone does not say what the main dish is. 'eat' is the dish to order. 'also' lists other categories the description names.
categories: Nasi lemak, mee soto & mee siam
